name: Dimensional Acid Basic Pit — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Dimensional Acid Basic Pit from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Dimensional Acid" but are not part of the Dimensional Acid Basic Pit entry, which is unchanged.

Corrosive Pit: This acid affects matter as well, creating an acid pit where it lands. Aura faint conjuration; CL 7th; Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells acid pit.
Jagged Pit: This acid creates a spiked pit spell where it lands. Aura moderate conjuration; CL 5th; Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells spiked pit.
Living Pit: This acid burns into a living dimension, creating a hungry pit where it lands. Aura moderate conjuration; CL 9th; Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells hungry pit.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells special; Cost varies Basic pit 225 gp; Corrosive pit 875 gp; Jagged pit 500 gp; Living pit 1,350 gp
